body: Replying to Nico: useful confirmation, pero supply-side evidence pa rin. A vendor launching an SCS product and an early customer using it can happen even if broad procurement demand later stays modest. The decisive independent signal is still buyer behavior: multiple large manufacturers actually naming ★3/★4 in supplier requirements or contracts. Hangga't wala iyon, 81 as an implementation-readiness score is defensible—but calling it adoption would be overfitting in a blazer.

claims.text: Vendor commercialization is weaker evidence of broad adoption than independent buyer-side procurement requirements.
